items.question: Q: I am a newly admitted lawyer. Do I need to comply with the MCLE requirements?
items.answer:
A: Yes.

The MCLE compliance requirements for newly admitted lawyers depend on the date of admission and the applicable compliance period.

items.question: Q: How many credit units must a newly admitted lawyer earn?
items.answer:
A: Depending on when the lawyer is admitted during the compliance period:

 
  • 36 CU if admitted at the start of the compliance period.
  • 24 CU if admitted during the first year of the compliance period.
  • 12 CU if admitted during the second year of the compliance period.
  • No MCLE requirement if admitted during the final four months of the compliance period.

lecturers.name: Atty. Gerald R. Yu
lecturers.topics: Recent Updates in Taxation, Taxation
lecturers.summary:
Atty. Gerald R. Yu, CPA, is a distinguished lawyer, certified public accountant, notary public, certified real estate broker, and certified life insurance broker based in Cebu. He is the founder and principal lawyer of Yu Law Office, where he specializes in corporate, tax, estate, and property law matters. 【1-ec65d0】

Atty. Yu graduated Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Laws degree from the University of San Jose-Recoletos and Summa Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Science in Accountancy degree from Cebu Institute of Technology-University. His outstanding academic performance earned him numerous honors, including recognition as one of the Ten Outstanding Students in Region 7. 【1-ec65d0】

Before entering private legal practice, he gained valuable experience in accounting and auditing, serving as an Associate Auditor with KPMG-Laya Mananghaya & Co. His strong foundation in both law and finance enables him to provide practical, strategic, and well-rounded advice to clients facing complex legal and business concerns. 【1-ec65d0】

A dedicated educator, Atty. Yu has been teaching law for more than a decade at the University of San Jose-Recoletos School of Law and the University of Southern Philippines Foundation School of Law. He has handled various subjects, including Taxation Law, Succession, Obligations and Contracts, Legal Research, Transportation Law, Environmental Law, and other core legal disciplines. 【1-ec65d0】【2-2c757b】

Beyond his legal practice and teaching career, Atty. Yu is a sought-after lecturer and resource speaker on taxation, corporate governance, business law, competition law, and other contemporary legal issues. Through his professional work, academic contributions, and commitment to public service, he continues to shape future legal practitioners and contribute meaningfully to the legal and business communities in Cebu and beyond.

lecturers.name: Judge Silvino T. Pampilo, Jr.
lecturers.topics: Legal and Judicial Ethics, Oral Advocacy, Katarungang Pambarangay Law, Public International Law, RA 9165, Updates in Civil Procedure, Outline in Intra-Corporate Controversies and Conflict of Jurisdiction between SEC and Commercial Courts
lecturers.summary:
Judge Silvino T Pampilo Jr is a distinguished legal luminary whose illustrious career as a multi-awarded magistrate and esteemed educator has left an indelible mark on the Philippine judiciary and legal education landscape. He is the retired Presiding Judge of the Regional Trial Court Branch 26 in Manila. Previously, as the Acting Presiding Judge of Branch 67 in Binangonan Rizal. Judge Pampilo Jr. has garnered widespread recognition for his unwavering commitment to upholding justice and the rule of law.

In addition to his judicial responsibilities, Judge Pampilo Jr. also shares his vast knowledge and expertise as a Professional Lecturer at the University of Rizal System Graduate School and as a Professor of Law in Mercantile Law, Political Law, and Remedial Law at esteemed institutions such as the University of the East, Philippine Law School, and the Polytechnic University of the Philippines. With a passion for legal education and a dedication to nurturing the next generation of legal minds, Judge Pampilo Jr stands as a beacon of excellence in both the courtroom and the classroom.
